structured.answer: After 8 years, putting in 500 ₪ a month (48,000 ₪ in total), the calculator says about 68,853 ₪ "נשאר בידיים". After 4 years it gives no figure for the fund, because for self-employed people it doesn't calculate taking the money out before 6 years ("לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב"). The 25,725 shown at 4 years belongs to a securities account, not the fund.

stuck.why: A big number, 25,725, sat alone at the top and I first took it as the fund's amount. Only after scrolling down did I see that its label is 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך'.
The task gave no amount, so I left the 500 ₪ the page had already filled in. I don't know if that's a sensible amount for me.

No figure at all for taking the money out early as a self-employed person, which is exactly what I came to ask
